Engineering task: Structuring the M1 artefact set against the Milestone 1 brief and Master Project Brief
AI contribution: Produced a candidate artefact list, section structure for the PED and register templates
Human verification: Cross-checked every proposed artefact against Milestone 1 section 3 required outputs and the grading criteria. Two suggested artefacts with no assessed purpose were removed; the FEC register was restructured to carry the four fields the brief explicitly requires.
Issues found: Initial structure omitted the assumption register even though Master Project Brief section 12 requires assumptions to be considered for risk treatment. Added.

Engineering task: Drafting candidate functional and non-functional requirements from the CivicConnect scenario
AI contribution: Generated a candidate requirement set with draft acceptance criteria
Human verification: Every requirement was traced back to a Master Project Brief section 3 capability or a section 2 stated problem. Requirements without a traceable source were deleted. Nine NFRs were rewritten because the generated versions used unmeasurable language such as 'fast', 'user-friendly' and 'secure'.
Issues found: The model proposed an AI-based automatic triage feature that no stakeholder asked for. Rejected as scope creep and recorded as SCOPE-O-07.

Engineering task: Independent critique of the draft requirement set for testability
AI contribution: Reviewed each acceptance criterion and flagged those that were not objectively verifiable
Human verification: The flags were assessed by hand against the verification method column. Four acceptance criteria were rewritten to state a measurable outcome and a verification route; one flag was rejected because the criterion was already testable at boundary values.
Issues found: Cross-model review surfaced that the original NFR-001 had no stated concurrency or data volume, making it untestable.

Engineering task: Drafting the risk register and forward engineering considerations
AI contribution: Generated candidate risks with probability and impact ratings
Human verification: Generic entries such as 'team communication problems' and 'technical difficulties' were deleted for failing the specificity standard in Master Project Brief section 12. Each retained risk was rewritten with a named cause and a contingency distinct from its mitigation. Probability and impact were re-rated by the team rather than accepted as generated.
Issues found: The generated register missed the governance deadlock created by requiring two approvals in a three-person team. RSK-04 was added by the team.

Engineering task: Drafting the GitHub governance procedure and pull request template
AI contribution: Produced branch protection settings, a commit convention and a review checklist
Human verification: Each setting was applied in the live repository and verified by attempting a direct push to main and a self-approved merge; both were correctly refused. Screenshots retained alongside the settings evidence.
Decision: Accepted and verified in the live repository
Issues found: The draft did not account for branch protection availability on the GitHub plan in use; the team verified the plan and repository visibility before relying on the control.

Engineering task: Analysis of stakeholder conflicts and scope exclusion rationale
AI contribution: Proposed conflict pairings and candidate resolutions
Human verification: Each proposed conflict was tested against the scenario text for evidence that both positions are genuinely held. One proposed conflict was discarded as invented. The resolutions were rewritten to name the artefact that implements them so the resolution is traceable rather than rhetorical.
Issues found: The generated exclusion rationale asserted cost figures that were not evidenced. Replaced with the constraint reference and an explicit statement of the evidence still required.

Engineering task: Transcribing docs/PED/*.md source files from the compiled, signed-off PED_v1.0_CivicConnect.docx (DEC-002 markdown source had never been populated)
AI contribution: Extracted all 16 PED sections from the compiled document and wrote them into their matching markdown stub files, replacing the placeholder comments; cross-checked every table against the CSV registers for identifier consistency
Human verification: Verified that the AI replaced the placeholder comments with the actual content from the project document instead of hallucinating or assuming new content. Reviewed the diff for all 16 files.
